_comment: Project fidelity config for SPX home 快捷功能 strip 619:8208 (5 instances × QuickAction). Same tolerances/gate as cards/compliance/transfer-state. checkTextContainerStyle=true so the QuickAction circle (48×48 #eabb62@0.20 radius 25.71) is anchored from the label below it — critical for verifying the gold-tint background.
_fontAliasNote: Figma labels CJK as 'HarmonyOS Sans TC'; app ships HarmonyOS Sans SC + Plus Jakarta Sans Latin — same alias contract as cards/auth/dialogs/compliance.

deviations.reason: Figma VECTOR child = an SVG <path> with stroke #EABB62 1.5px. Impl renders react-native-svg <Path stroke=...> which carries the same paint, but extract-impl reads CSS getComputedStyle — SVG `stroke` is a paint attribute, NOT a CSS border, so it reads as the default #e5e7eb. icon-diff already verifies the path-set is identical (figma SVG ↔ impl Path d-attribute), so this borderColor diff is the same impedance gap documented in figma-button-master 451:4629 / loading vector — applies to ALL 10 Vector children of the 5 icon frames here. Approved 2026-05-28.

Same SVG-stroke-vs-CSS-border impedance as Vector borderColor — figma reports stroke-width 1.5 as borderWidth, impl <path> CSS borderWidth is 0. icon-diff confirms the stroke is rendered correctly. Approved 2026-05-28.

Exchange icon's fill-vector children (I619:8212;586:7211/7212 Refresh arrows) — figma's VECTOR absoluteBoundingBox excludes the path's stroke half-width while impl <path>.getBoundingClientRect includes it. Path data is identical (icon-diff PASS); the ~1-2px width delta is the stroke inflation. Approved 2026-05-28.

Same stroke-inflation as Vector box.w — affects the Refresh arrows and the 8×0 PayoutsMark dividers (zero-height stroked lines getBoundingClientRect-ed as 1.5px tall in impl). icon-diff still confirms path identity. Approved 2026-05-28.

PayoutsMark's clipboard-clip vector (I619:8213;586:7218) has cornerRadius 1.5 inside the figma path; impl renders the path geometrically (rounded corners baked into the d-attribute) so there's no separate CSS border-radius. Visually identical, icon-diff PASS. Approved 2026-05-28.

Figma's 24×24 icon FRAME (I619:8213;586:7214) has cornerRadius 5 as a clip mask in the master. Impl renders the SVG inside a plain 24×24 View — clipping is implicit in the viewBox, so no border-radius needed on the wrapper. The visible glyph matches 1:1 (icon-diff PASS). Approved 2026-05-28.

_iconDeviationsNote: All 5 QuickAction icons are now true Figma SVGs (DepositMark / WithdrawMark / TransferMark / ExchangeMark / PayoutsMark, generated 1:1 by svg-to-component.mjs). NO iconDeviations are permitted here — that was the whole point of this harness, per Charlie's 2026-05-28 directive that the home strip glyphs must match figma exactly. The deviations[] above only document the SVG-stroke-vs-CSS-border impedance mismatch that the icon-diff path-set check already supersedes.
_uxNote: Press is the primary affordance of the 5 quick-action buttons. RN Pressable applies an opacity dim on pressIn → translates to a pointerdown opacity change on rn-web. requireTransitionOn:opacity asserts the dim eases rather than snaps.
